accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1 / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Complete recovery is conditional on every adaptively requested measured pair belonging to the observed-law version-stability domain; the unchanged published conditions are not asserted to establish this.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: RankPeel identifies the adjacency up to within-layer latent relabeling on complete runs over the stated observed-law oracle domain.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 4--5, Condition 2, Condition 3, Theorems 1--3; pp. 15--18, Appendix A.2 and A.7
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states the Jacobian-rank/d-separator relation, recursive surrogate theorem, and adjacency identification; Appendix A.7 explicitly searches all subsets for pure children and all parent subsets, while Appendix A.2 differentiates an induced h(g(x)) although Condition 3 explicitly makes only g continuously differentiable.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1, abstract and contribution bullets; pp. 1--2, Section 2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: This is a linear latent-hierarchy rank-deficiency method that recovers the graph's Markov equivalence class asymptotically under its own structural restrictions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1, abstract; pp. 1--2, Introduction and Section 2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies nonlinear hierarchical structures and latent variables up to invertible transformations using a distinct representation-recovery route.

The article gives a graph-theoretic trek-separation characterization of covariance-submatrix rank constraints for Gaussian graphical models, distinct from the proposed nonlinear conditional-mean oracle.
The paper studies nonregular inference for matrix-rank hypotheses, not population reconstruction of nonlinear latent hierarchies.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Prove a concrete sufficient support/version-regularity theorem that places all RankPeel queries in Q_stab, with a smooth counterexample immediately outside it; this would remove the principal complete-run qualification.
Add a decision-tree lower bound over a faithful graph family to determine whether the quadratic query budget is optimal up to logarithms.
Include a worked non-Gaussian complete-run instance whose transcript lists every query and verifies the p^2+p accounting under an explicit oracle-cost convention.

recommended_next_step: Advance this conditional field-tier algorithmic-identification proposal to Stage 0, retaining the complete-run caveat as settled scope.
